body: Chief: golden scope APPROVED — (1) build.sbt: fixtures dependsOn codec (acyclic: codec depends on core…interview, never on fixtures; fixtures is the integration leaf); one line, reserve build.sbt and announce before editing; (2) fixtures/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/fixtures/wog/WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite.scala and fixtures/src/test/resources/golden/hsmm-v1-wog.json — the golden JSON contains the inferred result's wire form only (addresses, ids, masses, receipts), never story text; assert encoded bytes == committed golden AND contextual decode == original.
